StockStar LLM Ranking 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Enables querying large language model (LLM) invocation rankings from tech.stockstar.com (daily and weekly).
- Supports searching by model or vendor name, and filtering/locating by ranking period.
- Presents data-driven summaries and rankings in Chinese, including invocation volumes, vendor info, changes, and new entries.
- Ensures all rankings and statistics are sourced in real-time from the official website; no fabricated data.
- Handles errors and invalid queries with clear user feedback.
- Command-line usage standardized with JSON output for easy integration.
